strings.api.Lifecycle: Define setup() and update(). setup runs once; update runs each frame. Script errors are logged and disable that instance.
strings.api.GameObject:
gameObject.id, gameObject.transform
GameObject.Find(nameOrId)
gameObject:GetComponent("Transform")
gameObject:SetParent(parent), IsDescendantOf(parent), IsCollidingWith(other), IsOverlappingTrigger(other), AddHUD()
GetComponent may return nil. Destroy(rigidbody) removes physics.
strings.api.Transform:
transform.position, localPosition, eulerAngles, localEulerAngles, localScale
transform:Translate(Vector3(x,y,z)), transform:Rotate(Vector3(x,y,z))
World and local properties differ; rotations use degrees.
strings.api.Vector3:
Vector3(x,y,z), x, y, z
v:length(), v:normalized(), Vector3.distance(a,b), lerp(a,b,t), dot(a,b), cross(a,b). Supports arithmetic.
strings.api.Color: Color(r,g,b,a): r, g, b, a channels.
strings.api.Input:
Input.GetKey("Space") -> boolean
Input.GetAxis("Horizontal" or "Vertical") -> number
Input.GetMouseDelta() -> x,y
Input.SetMouseCaptured(true) captures the cursor.
strings.api.Time:
Time.deltaTime: elapsed seconds, capped at 0.1.
Time.time: accumulated script time.
strings.api.Debug: Debug.Log(value), print(...): write to the editor Lua console.
strings.api.Camera:
GetComponent("Camera"): fieldOfView, aspect, nearClipPlane, farClipPlane, orthographic, orthographicSize, backgroundColor, useSkybox, forward, viewportWidth, viewportHeight
:worldToScreen(world), :screenToWorld(screen), :traceRay(range,ignore,x,y).
strings.api.Lights:
GetComponent("DirectionalLight"), "PointLight", "SpotLight"
color, intensity; directional: direction, ambient; point/spot: position, constant, linear, quadratic; spot: direction, innerCutoff, outerCutoff, worldPosition, worldDirection
SpotLight:GetWorldDirection(), SetInnerCutoff(degrees), SetOuterCutoff(degrees). Directional/spot: shadows, shadowDistance, shadowBias, shadowStrength.
strings.api.Sound:
GetComponent("SoundListener").enabled
GetComponent("SoundPlayer"): clip, volume, pitch, radius, looping, playOnAwake. No Lua playback control methods are exposed.
strings.api.HUD:
local hud = gameObject:AddHUD()
local label = hud:Add("text", "Hello")
hud.enabled, hud.count, hud:Get(index) (zero-based)
HudElement: text, visible, width, height, scale, position, absolute
:SetScreenPosition(Vector3(x,y,0)), :ConsumeClick() -> boolean.
HUD:Find(id), Get(id/index); Add(type,text,parent ID/index).
Any widget can contain children. absolute=true, relative=true, 160x40 by default; absolute=false enables flow.
HudElement: id, callback, font (.ttf/.otf), image (PNG/JPEG), shader (GLSL), opacity, color, background, hoverColor, pressedColor, borderColor, borderSize, borderRadius, padding, margin, alignment.
Free layout: absolute=true; relative=false selects viewport coordinates. Colors are assigned with Color(r,g,b,a).
strings.api.Compatibility: Legacy bubble.log, bubble.input, bubble.entity and bubble.transform remain available. Prefer the typed API for new scripts.
strings.Use a Hierarquia para escolher a entidad: Use Hierarchy to select an entity. Stop the game to edit keyframes.
strings.Crie ou atribua um arquivo .banim ao com: Create or assign a .banim file to the Animation component.
No changes recorded in this clip.
strings.Alteração inválida; verifique tempo, dur: Invalid change; check time, duration and value.
strings.Corrija o arquivo ou suas dependências e: Fix the file or its dependencies and try again. The original was preserved.
strings.Arraste para orbitar · use a roda do mou: Drag to orbit · use the mouse wheel to zoom.
strings.Todos os arquivos da pasta serão apagado: All files in the folder will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
strings.Esta ação não pode ser desfeita. Alteraç: This action cannot be undone. Unsaved changes will be discarded. File references may become missing.
strings.A trilha mudou; tente mover a chave nova: The track changed; try moving the key again.
strings.Não foi possível mover: já existe uma ch: Cannot move: another key already exists at this time.
strings.api.Animation:
gameObject:GetComponent("Animation")
Play(clip?), Pause(), Stop(), Seek(seconds), SetSpeed(0..100), CrossFade(clip, seconds) return boolean. Commands apply on the next animation update. time, isPlaying and isBlending report the last update. Clip paths are relative to the project. CrossFade blends numeric channels; discrete channels switch halfway.
strings.Arraste os losangos na régua de cada tri: Drag diamonds on each track ruler to move keys.
strings.Mostra um intervalo maior da animação na: Shows a larger time range in the animation timeline.
strings.Amplia o espaço entre os tempos para edi: Increases the space between times for precise keyframe editing.
strings.Ative Gravar no painel Animação.\nAltere:
Enable Record in the Animation panel.
Change this bone pose to create keys.
The .banim clip moves bones, not the entity.
strings.Repouso não deforma a malha.\nUse o modo:
Rest pose does not deform the mesh.
Use Vertices mode to adjust weights.
Save the .bmodel before recording poses.
strings.Salve o .bmodel antes de editar ou grava: Save the .bmodel before editing or recording bone poses.
strings.Rig modificado. Salve o .bmodel antes de: Rig modified. Save the .bmodel before recording pose animations.
strings.Selecione um modelo .bmodel editável e p: Select an editable .bmodel and stop playback.
strings.Crie os ossos, ajuste a hierarquia e vin: Create bones, adjust their hierarchy and bind the mesh to the rig.
strings.Este modelo não possui nós ou ossos edit: This model has no editable nodes or bones. Import a .bmodel copy to create a rig.
strings.Pare a reprodução e desbloqueie a entida: Stop playback and unlock the entity to edit the rig.
strings.Reatribua ou remova os ossos filhos ante: Reparent or remove the child bones before deleting this bone.
Weight must be between zero and one.
strings.Use Editar repouso e pesos antes de alte: Switch to Edit rest pose and weights before changing geometry.
strings.Cria um osso independente na origem do m: Creates an independent bone at the model origin. Adjust its rest pose and bind vertices before animating.
strings.Define a hierarquia do rig. A transforma: Defines the rig hierarchy. The rest transform is relative to this parent; cycles are rejected.
strings.Distribui pesos normalizados entre até q: Distributes normalized weights among up to four nearby bones per vertex. Then refine selected vertices manually.
strings.O modelo mudou durante a leitura. Seleci: The model changed while being read. Select it again.
strings.O arquivo do modelo mudou no disco. As e: The model file changed on disk. Local edits were retained; resolve the conflict before saving.
strings.Seleciona o modelo inteiro para mover, g: Selects the entire model for moving, rotating or scaling.
strings.Seleciona faces da malha. Use Shift para: Selects mesh faces. Hold Shift to add faces to the selection.
strings.Seleciona pontos da malha para ajustar a: Selects mesh points to adjust the model shape.
strings.Seleciona arestas da malha para editar s: Selects mesh edges to edit the topology.
strings.Mostra a geometria com sombreamento sóli: Shows geometry using neutral solid shading.
strings.Mostra as cores, texturas e materiais at: Shows the colors, textures and materials assigned to the meshes.
strings.Mostra o modelo com a iluminação e os ef: Shows the model with scene lighting and effects.
strings.Desfaz a última edição de geometria do m: Undoes the most recent geometry edit in the current model.
strings.Reaplica a edição de geometria desfeita: Reapplies the most recently undone geometry edit.
strings.Cria volume a partir das faces seleciona: Creates volume from selected faces using the extrusion distance.
strings.Organiza as faces selecionadas em um gru: Groups the selected faces so they can be selected again.
strings.Adiciona um corte contínuo na malha a pa: Adds a continuous cut through the mesh from the selected edges.
strings.Grava no arquivo .bmodel as alterações p: Writes the pending model changes to the .bmodel file.
strings.Extrai as malhas escolhidas para um novo: Extracts selected meshes to a new file while preserving the original model.
strings.Alterna entre olhar livremente e orbitar: Switches between free look and orbiting around the model. Drag with the right mouse button.
strings.Ajusta a câmera de prévia para mostrar o: Adjusts the preview camera to show the entire model.
strings.Abre a timeline para gravar e editar ani: Opens the timeline to record and edit animations of the entity and its bones.
strings.Cor do céu. Câmeras novas usam cinza neu: Sky color. New cameras use neutral gray: Color(0.16, 0.16, 0.16, 1). Existing explicit colors are preserved.
strings.REPRODUZINDO PRÉVIA · sem gravar keyfram: PLAYING PREVIEW · no keyframes recorded; Ctrl+Z undoes.
strings.GRAVANDO · altere os valores no Inspecto: RECORDING · edit values in the Inspector; keys are created automatically.
strings.Animação antiga: Save Project criará o a: Legacy animation: Save Project will create the clip file.
strings.Clipe modificado · Salvar clipe ou Save: Clip modified · use Save clip or Save Project to write the file.
strings.Ative Gravar e altere propriedades no In: Enable Record and edit properties in the Inspector. Click the ruler to preview.
strings.Arraste para pintar o peso da seleção. A:
Drag to paint the selection weight. Blue = 0; red = 1.
Paint passes through the active mesh. Esc cancels; Ctrl+Z undoes the stroke.
strings.Pesos pintados. Salve o .bmodel para man: Weights painted. Save the .bmodel to keep the changes.
